bio.text: Karina Villa, a Democrat, has served in the Illinois Senate since 2021, representing the 25th District, after serving in the Illinois House from 2019 to 2020, according to the General Assembly.
The General Assembly biography describes Villa as a lifelong resident of the 25th Senate District and the child of immigrant parents and small business owners.

It says Villa holds a master's degree in social work from Aurora University, worked as a social worker in the West Chicago and Villa Park school systems, and is a former vice president of the West Chicago District 33 Board of Education.
